task_description: Phase 4 PRODUCTION HARDENING (v0.4.0) for the xplainit-framework: (4.1) security hardening - input sanitization, unsafe/FFI audit, secret redaction, dependency audit; (4.2) error recovery - graceful degradation, circuit breaker, error isolation, telemetry; (4.3) performance optimization - reduce cloning/allocations, Arc/zero-copy, offline bench harness; (4.4) extensive testing - unit/edge/hand-rolled property/integration/load tests; (4.5) documentation completion - warning-free cargo doc, Markdown user guide, reference docs, status corrections. Executed one task at a time in order on branch phase4-production-hardening, committed per-feature. No PRs; orchestrator fast-forward-merges into master.
